How plain text recovery works

Recovery recognizes the alphabets used by this site and removes its underline and strike marks. It does not transliterate every script or erase accents. Small caps and superscripts can lose original case, so review the result.

Where it helps

Use this when a styled name is hard to search, a form rejects decorative text, or you need an ordinary-text alternative. Check ambiguous letters before using the recovered text in an important document.
